theater: 羅馬、安提奧克與北不列顛戰線

battle.name: 五帝之年
battle.theater: 羅馬、安提奧克與北不列顛戰線
battle.brief: 公元193年，塞維魯皇帝在不列顛戰死，皇位在一年之內四度易手，其中一回是禁衛軍用金錢買下的；敘利亞與不列顛的軍團各自擁立新主，帝國內戰全面鋪開。卡面的埃及長矛是青銅矛頭綁在木杆上的遠古形制，193年時早已退居帝國武庫，它映照的正是這場內戰裡兵備的混亂與傳統的斷裂。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 公元193年的羅馬帝國，因一次皇位繼承危機而分裂成數個武裝陣營，一年之內出現五位皇帝：塞維魯、其子蓋塔、禁衛軍扶立的佩蒂納克斯、靠金錢買到禁衛軍支持的狄迪烏斯·尤利安努斯，以及分別在東方與西方自立為王的涅吉爾與阿爾比努斯。交戰的一方是中央：塞維魯王朝的御前集團、元老院、首都禁衛軍與各行省軍團。禁衛軍駐紮在維米納爾丘的營區，緊鄰皇宮，是唯一能在幾刻鐘之內決定皇帝生死的力量；元老院沒有兵，卻握著宣布合法與非法的權柄；城市守夜隊與禁衛軍分屬兩個指揮系統，互為牽制。帝國軍團方面，敘利亞有第三高盧、第四敘利亞、第六費拉塔、第十六弗拉維亞·菲爾瑪四個軍團，埃及有第二十二狄奧塔利安納軍團與亞歷山大港的駐防艦隊，不列顛有第二奧古斯塔、第二十瓦勒里亞·維克圖里克斯、第六維克圖里克斯三個軍團，萊茵與多瑙河線另有常備守軍。另一方是帝位競爭者：敘利亞總督涅吉爾得到元老派與東方軍團的支持，不列顛總督阿爾比努斯被本島軍團推舉，率軍侵入高盧與西班牙。更外圍是邊疆的叛亂者與海盜：埃及西部沙漠的烏薩比人與的黎波里塔尼亞的馬薩奇人舉兵，東部沙漠的布勒米耶人趁勢騷擾，提爾海與奇里乞亞兩路的海盜集團趁內戰劫掠地中海航線。
countriesEn: The Roman Empire of AD 193 split into several armed camps after a succession crisis, and five emperors appeared within a single year: Septimius Severus, his son Geta, Pertinax, whom the Praetorian Guard elevated, Didius Julianus, whose elevation the Guard sold for money, and the rival claimants Pescennius Niger in the east and Clodius Albinus in the west. One side was the centre: the Severan court group, the senate, the Praetorian Guard of the capital, and the provincial legions. The Guard was barracked on the Viminal, hard against the imperial palace, and was the only force able to decide the life or death of an emperor within a few moments; the senate had no troops of its own but held the power to declare who was lawful and who was not; the city watch and the Guard belonged to separate chains of command and checked each other. On the army side, Syria held the Third Gallica, Fourth Scythica, Sixth Ferrata and Sixteenth Flavia Firma, Egypt had the Twenty-Second Deiotariana and the garrison flotilla at Alexandria, Britain had the Second Augusta, Twentieth Valeria Victrix and Sixth Victrix, and the Rhine and Danube lines had their own permanent garrisons. The other side were the claimants to the throne: Pescennius Niger, governor of Syria, backed by the senatorial party and the eastern legions, and Clodius Albinus, governor of Britain, acclaimed by the legions on the island, who carried his army into Gaul and Spain. Further out were the frontier insurgents and the pirates: the Usabians of the western Egyptian desert and the Masaei of Tripolitania rose in revolt, the Blemyyes of the eastern desert took the opportunity to harry the roads, and pirate bands from the Tyrrhenian Sea and from Cilicia used the civil war to raid the Mediterranean lanes.
people: 關鍵人物幾乎全在皇族、禁衛軍與兩位行省總督之間。塞維魯皇帝本人於193年2月4日在不列顛的埃博拉庫姆病逝，遺體送回羅馬後於坎圖斯·馬爾提烏斯廣場焚化，禁衛軍在柴堆旁互相推擠爭奪賞錢，成為本朝最不堪的場面之一。他的兩個兒子卡卡拉與蓋塔隨即爭位：卡卡拉隨母親茱莉亞·多姆納留在安提奧克，蓋塔在禁衛軍與元老院之間周旋，3月19日被立為共治皇帝。禁衛軍首領提蒂亞努斯與卡斯特爾、薩奥特魯斯支持蓋塔卻未能控制局面；塞維魯的岳父、禁衛軍長蘇爾皮基阿努斯在首都重整秩序，6月即病逝。佩蒂納克斯時年六十六歲，歷任禁衛軍長與城市守備長，在禁衛軍推舉下於3月31日即位，拒絕讓禁衛軍闖入皇宮搶奪錢櫃，4月1日晨被殺，後來由元老院追認為神。狄迪烏斯·尤利安努斯時年五十九歲，出身米蘭的資產家庭，靠向禁衛軍承諾每人二萬五千賽斯特斯而於4月1日被推上皇位，6月6日又被同一批禁衛軍殺死，並被元老院追為公敵。東線的關鍵人物是敘利亞總督涅吉爾、元老院代表提貝里烏斯·克勞狄烏斯·坎迪杜斯，以及將軍奎厄圖斯與拉貝里烏斯·馬克西莫斯；西線則是不列顛總督阿爾比努斯與禁衛軍長拉埃圖斯。
peopleEn: The decisive figures sat almost entirely among the imperial family, the Praetorian Guard and two provincial governors. Septimius Severus himself died of illness at Eboracum in Britain on 4 February 193; his body was brought back to Rome and burned on the Campus Martius, where the Guard shoved and grappled around the pyre in a scramble for the largess, in one of the most sordid scenes of the dynasty. His two sons, Caracalla and Geta, immediately began to contest the succession: Caracalla stayed in Antioch with their mother Julia Domna, while Geta manoeuvred between the Guard and the senate and was made co-emperor on 19 March. The head of the Guard, Titianus, and the prefects Castor and Saoterus backed Geta but could not hold the situation; Sulpicianus, Severus' father-in-law and prefect of the Guard, restored order in the capital and died of illness that June. Pertinax was sixty-six, had served as prefect of the Guard and as prefect of the city, and was acclaimed emperor on 31 March after the Guard had put him forward; he refused to let the Guard storm the palace for the treasury, and was killed in the early hours of 1 April, and was later deified by the senate. Didius Severus Julianus was fifty-nine, came from a wealthy family at Mediolanum, and was raised to the throne on 1 April after promising the Guard twenty-five thousand sestertii apiece; on 6 June the same Guard murdered him, and the senate branded him a public enemy. The key men in the east were Pescennius Niger, governor of Syria, the senatorial emissary Tiberius Claudius Candidus, and the generals Quietus and Laberius Maximus; in the west they were Clodius Albinus, governor of Britain, and the prefect Marcus Junius Laetus.
kits: 卡面是埃及長矛：早王朝時期的形制，銅或青銅矛頭以綁扎固定在木杆上，埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。這件兵器在193年早已不是前線裝備——帝國軍團手中是重標槍、短劍與橢圓大盾，禁衛軍通常配圓盾，較舊的樣式只留在輔助軍團與埃及本地徵召兵手上；它真正的位置是對照件與武庫遺產。第一，銅矛頭綁木杆是近戰刺槍的源頭，羅馬軍中的長矛（hasta）正是這種形制的後裔，卡卡拉在212年取消軍團前排的重標槍、以長矛取代它作為標準近戰配備，等於把這件卡面上的舊形制帶回軍陣。第二，埃及在公元前30年之後已是帝國行省，亞歷山大港與帝國中央的武庫裡仍存有這類舊銅器，多半被收作禮器、賞賜或陳列。第三，本役的戰場上確有守城與收復失地的場面：阿爾比努斯在西班牙、高盧與不列顛需要重新奪回城池，塞維魯在東方要收回被叛軍占據的行省首府，埃及邊疆的烏薩比人與布勒米耶人起事也逼得當地守軍沿沙漠路綫據點死守——這正是「守城垣、收復失地」的老用途在帝國末年的最後一次演譯。同期真正上戰場的裝備包括重標槍（pilum）、短劍（gladius）、將官的半長刺劍（parazonium）、橢圓大盾（scutum）、鎖子甲與鱗甲、縱列鐵甲（lorica segmentata）、帶面頰護具的羅馬盔（galea）、各類弩砲與配備攻城塔、投石機的圍城器材，以及軍旗、標幟、號角、帳篷、輜重車隊與海運船隊。
kitsEn: The card shows an Egyptian spear: an early dynastic form, a copper or bronze head lashed to a wooden shaft, used by the Egyptians to defend city walls and later to recover lost ground. By AD 193 this weapon was no longer a front-line item: the imperial legions carried the heavy pilum, the gladius and the oval scutum, the Praetorian Guard wore the round clipeus, and older patterns survived only in the auxiliary formations and in locally recruited Egyptian troops. Its real place in this war is as a reference piece and as arsenal property. First, the bronze head bound to a wooden shaft is the ancestor of the close-combat thrusting spear, and the Roman hasta is the direct descendant of that form; when Caracalla in AD 212 struck the heavy pilum from the front rank of the legions and substituted the hasta as the standard close-combat arm, he carried the old shape on the card back into the line. Second, since 30 BC Egypt had been a province of the empire, and old copper pieces of this type were still kept in the arsenal at Alexandria and in the imperial storehouses, where they served chiefly as ceremonial gifts, awards or display objects. Third, there were genuinely sieges and recoveries of lost ground in this war: Albinus had to retake towns in Spain, Gaul and Britain, Severus had to recover provincial capitals held by rebels in the east, and the rising of the Usabians and Blemyyes in Egypt forced the local garrisons to hold fortified points along the desert roads. That was the old use of defending walls and recovering lost ground, performed for the last time in the late empire. The equipment actually carried into battle at the time included the heavy pilum, the gladius, the officer's parazonium, the oval scutum, mail and scale armour, the segmented lorica segmentata, the galea with cheek pieces, the various bolt throwers, the siege towers and stone-throwers of siege work, and the standards, signa, horns, tents, baggage wagons and sea transport of the trains.
tactics: 這場內戰有兩套邏輯，一套在首都，一套在戰場。首都這一端，禁衛軍營與皇宮的距離約一公里，守夜隊的崗位橫亙全城，誰控制維米納爾丘誰就控制皇帝。佩蒂納克斯的辦法是硬碰硬：封閉營區、按次發放賞金、禁止士兵闖入皇宮，結果在夜裡被禁衛軍攻入皇宮刺殺；狄迪烏斯·尤利安努斯的辦法則是買，把皇位當作競價標的，用現金承諾把禁衛軍拉到自己一邊，元老院被迫在數小時之內追認既成事實。東線與西線則是常規戰爭：塞維魯自潘諾尼亞南下，先解安提奧克之圍，再以規模較小但指揮統一的部隊在伊蘇斯（193年夏）主動出擊涅吉爾麾下安努利努斯握有的優勢兵力，奪取戰場主動；對方倚仗人數與既有防線，卻在一次野戰中崩潰，涅吉爾節節敗退至小亞細亞。埃及邊疆又是另一種節奏：沙漠游騎劫掠糧道與村鎮，羅馬方以小分隊、營壘與給水線追擊，亞歷山大港的艦隊切斷叛軍的外援。整體看，這是一場以時間與距離取勝的戰爭：塞維魯把首都留給禁衛軍，自己帶著可靠軍團在東方決定勝負，最終贏下；禁衛軍靠位置壟斷皇位，最後被這場戰爭連同它的特權一起清算。
tacticsEn: This civil war ran on two logics, one in the capital and one in the field. In the capital the distance between the Guard's barracks and the palace was about a kilometre, the watch posts of the city vigil covered the whole town, and whoever held the Viminal held the emperor. Pertinax chose to stand firm: he closed the barracks, paid out the donative piecemeal, and forbade the soldiers from entering the palace, and was consequently killed by the Guard in a night assault on the palace. Didius Julianus chose instead to buy, turning the throne into a lot to be knocked down, offering cash to bring the Guard over to him, and the senate was forced to ratify the accomplished fact within a matter of hours. The eastern and western fronts were conventional war: Severus marched south from Pannonia, relieved Antioch first, and then, with a smaller but tightly commanded force, took the initiative against Anullinus's superior numbers at Issus in the summer of 193, seizing the tactical initiative; his opponent, relying on numbers and an established line, collapsed in a single field engagement, and Niger fell back step by step into Asia Minor. The Egyptian frontier ran to a different rhythm: nomadic bands struck the grain roads and the villages, and the Roman side answered with detachments, camps and a chain of watering posts, while the flotilla at Alexandria cut the insurgents off from outside support. Taken as a whole, this was a war won by time and distance: Severus left the capital to the Guard, took the reliable legions with him into the east and settled the matter there, and won; the Guard, which had monopolised the throne through its position, was finally liquidated together with its privileges by the very war it had started.
data: 這場戰爭留下的數字密集而互相矛盾，多半出自勝方與事後的追述。時間線最清楚：193年2月4日塞維魯在埃博拉庫姆去世；3月31日佩蒂納克斯即位；4月1日佩蒂納克斯遇害、狄迪烏斯·尤利安努斯即位；6月6日尤利安努斯被殺並被追為公敵；同年內涅吉爾在東方戰敗，次年6月被處決於佩加蒙（Pergamon）；197年2月22日阿爾比努斯在里昂戰敗被殺；197年12月19日蓋塔被殺，卡卡拉自此獨攬大權。兩個在位時間短得可以記下：佩蒂納克斯在位八十六天，狄迪烏斯·尤利安努斯在位六十六天。金額方面，禁衛軍在新君即位時的慣例酬金為每人五千賽斯特斯，狄迪烏斯·尤利安努斯開出每人二萬五千賽斯特斯，這在羅馬史上是前所未有的價碼。兵力方面沒有可靠的總表，雙方的數字多被敵方誇大；可以確定的是禁衛軍規模在數千人的量級，卻握有首都的實際控制權，而敘利亞、不列顛與萊茵線的軍團各自只聽命於自己的指揮官。距離上，羅馬到埃博拉庫姆的陸路與海路合計約一千五百至一千六百公里，羅馬到安提奧克的海路約二千二百公里；塞維魯的部隊在東方靠海運與行省徵發維持，冬季的雨雪都會拖慢行列。傷亡數字基本不可用，可引的定性說法是：四年的內戰把萊茵與多瑙河的邊防軍團抽空大半，帝國邊界在193年至197年之間多次告急。
dataEn: The figures this war has left are dense and mutually contradictory, and most come from the winners or from later retrospectives. The timeline is the clearest part: Severus died at Eboracum on 4 February 193; Pertinax was acclaimed on 31 March; Pertinax was killed and Didius Julianus was raised on 1 April; Julianus was killed and branded a public enemy on 6 June; Niger was defeated in the east in the same year and was executed at Pergamon in June of the next; Albinus was beaten at Lugdunum and killed on 22 February 197; and Geta was killed on 19 December 197, after which Caracalla held sole power. Two reigns are short enough to be written down exactly: eighty-six days for Pertinax and sixty-six days for Didius Julianus. On money, the customary donative to the Guard on an accession was five thousand sestertii per man, and Didius Julianus offered twenty-five thousand sestertii apiece, a price without precedent in Roman history. On strength there is no reliable overall table, and the numbers on both sides were inflated by their enemies; what can be settled is that the Guard numbered on the order of a few thousand men while holding effective control of the capital, and that the legions of Syria, Britain and the Rhine line each obeyed only their own commander. On distance, the combined land and sea road from Rome to Eboracum runs to roughly fifteen hundred or sixteen hundred kilometres, and the sea route from Rome to Antioch about two thousand two hundred; Severus' troops in the east were sustained by sea transport and by requisition in the provinces, and the winter rains and snow slowed the marching columns. Casualty figures are essentially unusable; the one serviceable statement is qualitative: four years of civil war emptied out most of the frontier garrisons of the Rhine and the Danube, and the imperial frontiers were in serious danger more than once between 193 and 197.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。最外層是繼承機制失靈：塞維魯把帝國安排成家族事業，自己卻在北不列顛的前線病死，留下的是十四歲的卡卡拉與三歲的蓋塔，兩個共治者的任命彼此矛盾，禁衛軍與元老院各有算盤，而皇帝死在離羅馬一千六百公里的地方——這套以「皇帝在場」為前提的體制根本沒有備案。第二層是軍隊已經學會自己做主：192年12月31日禁衛軍廢掉康茂德，193年3月31日又扶起佩蒂納克斯，4月1日再殺死他，首都衛戍在幾個月內三次改立君主，這套辦法在193年被完整複製並升級成現金競價。第三層是元老院與皇室的對立：涅吉爾在188年被立為凱撒，本是元老院推舉的候選人，塞維魯卻在198年把自己的兒子立為凱撒並逐步推向共治，元老派因此把涅吉爾視為收回主導權的唯一希望，東方的元老與軍團自此合流。第四層是邊疆壓力同時爆開：不列顛的戰事、萊茵線的戰事、埃及的沙漠叛亂與地中海的海盜，趁中央空虛一起發作，把一場宮廷繼承危機放大成帝國層級的內戰。
causeEn: There were four layers of cause. The outermost was the failure of the succession mechanism: Severus had arranged the empire as a family undertaking, and then died of sickness on the northern British front, leaving a fourteen-year-old Caracalla and a three-year-old Geta, two co-emperors whose appointments contradicted each other, with the Guard and the senate each running their own arithmetic, and the emperor dead fifteen hundred kilometres from Rome. A system that assumed the emperor was present had no fallback. The second layer was that the army had already learned to make its own decisions: on 31 December 192 the Guard put out Commodus, on 31 March 193 they raised Pertinax, and on 1 April they killed him again; the capital garrison had changed the monarch three times in a few months, and in 193 that procedure was reproduced in full and upgraded into a cash auction. The third layer was the antagonism between the senate and the dynasty: Niger had been named Caesar in 188 as the candidate of the senatorial party, but Severus instead named his own son Caesar in 198 and pushed him steadily towards co-rule, so the senatorial party now saw Niger as its one hope of recovering the initiative, and senatorial opinion in the east and the eastern legions merged. The fourth layer was that pressure on the frontiers burst at the same moment: the war in Britain, the fighting on the Rhine, the desert revolt in Egypt and the pirates in the Mediterranean all broke out while the centre was empty, and what had been a succession crisis in the palace was turned into a civil war at the level of the empire.
impact: 193年留下的不是一場戰爭的勝負，而是一整套新的政治習慣。禁衛軍用錢買下皇帝，成了羅馬政治記憶裡最不堪的場景；此後一個半世紀裡，帝位被軍人抬上、壓下、拍賣、再拍賣，皇帝的更替快得像走馬燈，直到戴克里先以四帝共治、重整軍隊與稅制收拾局面。皇帝在首都被護衛軍殺死這件事本身，等於宣告元老院的權威只剩一層法律外衣：193年6月6日元老院可以把一位在位的皇帝宣布為公敵，卻救不了他的命，此後元老院在軍人皇帝面前再也沒有籌碼。制度上，塞維魯解散了殺掉康茂德與佩蒂納克斯的那支舊禁衛軍，重編禁衛步兵大隊、把營區設在城內、把指揮權分給城市守備長，完成了一次體制修補；但同時也把首都的槍桿子固定在皇帝腳下，後果由卡拉卡拉的弒兄與212年把公民權授予全體居民的敕令一路放大到三世紀末。東西方對比也從此定型：敘利亞成為帝國的兵源與皇族基地，東方軍團的態度屢次決定皇位，這條線一直延續到三世紀末。財政上，四年內戰抽乾國庫，軍隊薪給與皇帝巡行的開支都靠加稅與徵發維持。「五帝之年」最終是以軍隊的進步、帝國的壯大與制度的空心化三者同時發生收場。
impactEn: What 193 left behind was not the result of a battle but a whole new set of political habits. The Guard buying an emperor became the most sordid scene in Roman political memory; for the next century and a half the throne was lifted up, put down, auctioned and auctioned again by soldiers, the turnover of emperors ran like a revolving lantern, until Diocletian settled matters with the tetrarchy, a rebuilt army and a reformed tax system. The fact that an emperor was killed by his own guards in the capital announced that the authority of the senate was now a legal shell: on 6 June 193 the senate could declare a reigning emperor a public enemy but could not save his life, and from then on the senate had no bargaining counter left against the soldier-emperors. In institutional terms Severus closed the account by disbanding the old Guard that had killed Commodus and Pertinax, reorganising the guard cohorts, moving the barracks inside the city and dividing the command with the prefect of the city; but he also fixed the capital's weapon in the emperor's own hand, and the consequences of that ran from Caracalla's murder of his brother to the edict of 212 that gave citizenship to every free inhabitant of the empire, and on into the late third century. The contrast between east and west was likewise fixed from now on: Syria became the empire's reservoir of recruits and the base of the imperial family, and the attitude of the eastern armies repeatedly decided the throne, a line that runs straight through to the end of the third century. Financially four years of civil war drained the treasury, and the pay of the troops and the cost of the emperor's travels were met by new taxes and requisitions. The year of the five emperors thus closed with three things happening at once: the army grew stronger, the empire grew larger, and the institutions grew hollow.
result: 直接結果是帝國保住了，但代價是四年內戰與一個被掏空的體制。193年這一年，帝位四度易手：佩蒂納克斯在位八十六天，狄迪烏斯·尤利安努斯在位六十六天，兩人都死在首都的宮殿與禁衛軍營之間，元老院的最後一點威儀在6月6日被踩碎。東線在193年至194年間解決：涅吉爾的大軍在安提奧克與伊蘇斯接連崩潰，本人被押回小亞細亞於194年6月處決；西線拖到197年，塞維魯自東方趕回高盧，擊敗阿爾比努斯於里昂的軍隊，阿爾比努斯當日被殺，帝國境內再無另一位皇帝。禁衛軍的帳也結清了：塞維魯解散、貶黜並追賞那批殺死佩蒂納克斯的人，首都的槍桿子從此握在皇帝自己手裡；可真正收束局面的還要等到197年12月蓋塔被殺，卡卡拉獨攬大權，內戰才算結束。留下的制度性後果是三重的：皇帝可以死在自己人手上，軍隊可以用錢決定誰做皇帝，元老院可以宣布一位皇帝為公敵卻無力反抗。三件事在193年同時成立，此後一百五十年裡不斷重演。
resultEn: The immediate result was that the empire survived, at the price of four years of civil war and a hollowed-out system. In the year 193 alone the throne changed hands four times: Pertinax reigned eighty-six days, Didius Julianus sixty-six, and both of them died between the palace and the Guard barracks in the capital, and the last shred of the senate's dignity was trampled underfoot on 6 June. The eastern front was settled between 193 and 194: Niger's army collapsed in turn before Antioch and at Issus, and the man himself was dragged back into Asia Minor and executed in June 194. The western front dragged on until 197, when Severus came up from the east, broke Albinus' army at Lugdunum, and Albinus was killed the same day, after which there was no second emperor anywhere within the empire. The Guard's account was settled too: Severus disbanded, disgraced and rewarded the men who had killed Pertinax, and from then on the weapon of the capital lay in the emperor's own hand; but the situation was only truly closed in December 197, when Geta was killed and Caracalla took sole power, and the civil war was over. The institutional legacy that remained was threefold: an emperor could be killed by his own men, the troops could decide by money who should be emperor, and the senate could declare an emperor a public enemy while having no power to resist. All three were established in 193, and they were acted out again and again for the next hundred and fifty years.
